description: This Python test script uses pytest and unittest.mock to test the functionality of retrieving and handling run commands for various project types in the universalinit framework. It mocks the ProjectInitializer, templates, and configuration functions to verify correct behavior and output formatting.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Represents initial template configuration information, including command and working directory.

classes.name: RunTool
classes.description: Encapsulates the command to run a project and its working directory.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects, creating templates, and managing setup.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command
methods.description: Handles retrieval and output of the run command for a given project type.

methods.name: create_minimal_project_config
methods.description: Creates a minimal configuration object for a specified project type.
